# snipeit_component (Resource)

Manages a component in Snipe-IT. `purchase_cost` is intentionally not supported (the API returns it locale-formatted, which does not round-trip stably).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "snipeit_category" "ram" {
  name          = "RAM"
  category_type = "component"
}

resource "snipeit_component" "ddr5" {
  name        = "Kingston 32GB DDR5"
  qty         = 16
  category_id = snipeit_category.ram.id
  min_amt     = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category (must be a `component` category).
- `name` (String) Name of the component.
- `qty` (Number) Total quantity of this component.

### Optional

- `company_id` (Number) Id of the owning company.
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location.
- `min_amt` (Number) Minimum quantity before a low-stock alert triggers.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `order_number` (String) Order number of the purchase.
- `purchase_date` (String) Purchase date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `supplier_id` (Number) Id of the supplier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the component.
